column32: Description

column1: Account & Access
column32:
Business requirement: BR-01 - Customers must be able to register and log in. Restaurants and delivery partners must be able to log in.
Functional requirements: FR-01, FR-02
Use cases: UC-01 Register, UC-02 Verify OTP, UC-03 Login
Business rules: RULE-01
UAT: UAT-01, UAT-02

column1: Register with mobile number and email
column32:
As a customer, I want to register with my mobile number and email, so that I can create an account and order food.

Acceptance criteria
- Given I enter a valid unregistered mobile number and email, When I tap Get OTP, Then an OTP is sent by SMS.
- Given the registration details are invalid or the email already exists, Then an error is shown and no account is created (RULE-01).

Traceability: BR-01, FR-01, UC-01, RULE-01, UAT-01

column1: Verify OTP to complete registration
column32:
As a customer, I want to verify the OTP I receive, so that my mobile number is confirmed.

Acceptance criteria
- Given I enter the correct OTP, When I tap Verify OTP and Register, Then my account is created and I can log in.
- Given I enter an invalid OTP, Then an error is shown and the account is not created.

Traceability: BR-01, FR-01, UC-02, RULE-01, UAT-01

column1: Log in as customer, restaurant or delivery partner
column32:
As a customer, restaurant or delivery partner, I want to log in securely, so that I can reach my own home screen.

Acceptance criteria
- Given valid credentials for my role, When I log in, Then my role's home screen opens.
- Given an invalid password, Then an error is shown and access is denied.
- Passwords are stored as salted hashes (NFR-04).

Traceability: BR-01, FR-02, UC-03, UAT-02

column1: Browse restaurants and view menus
column32:
As a customer, I want to browse restaurants and view their menus, so that I can choose what to order.

Acceptance criteria
- Given I am logged in, When I open Home, Then the restaurant list is displayed and can be searched or scrolled.
- When I select a restaurant, Then its menu categories and items with prices are shown.

Traceability: BR-02, FR-03, UC-04, UAT-03

column1: Add items to cart and view or edit the cart
column32:
As a customer, I want to add items to a cart and edit it, so that I can review my order before paying.

Acceptance criteria
- Given I am viewing a menu, When I add items, Then they appear in the cart.
- When I increase a quantity or remove an item, Then items, quantities and total update correctly after each change.

Traceability: BR-03, FR-04, UC-05, UC-06, UAT-04

column1: Place order with delivery address and payment method
column32:
As a customer, I want to enter a delivery address and choose a payment method, so that I can place my order.

Acceptance criteria
- Given my cart is not empty, When I tap Checkout, Then I can enter a delivery address (max 200 characters).
- Only Google Pay and Paytm are offered; Cash on Delivery is not available (RULE-08).
- When I tap Place order & pay, Then the order is created with status Pending Payment.

Traceability: BR-03, FR-05, UC-07, RULE-08, UAT-05

column1: Ordering
column32:
Business requirements: BR-02 (browse restaurants and menus), BR-03 (cart and place order)
Functional requirements: FR-03, FR-04, FR-05
Use cases: UC-04, UC-05, UC-06, UC-07
Business rules: RULE-08 (online payment methods only)
UAT: UAT-03, UAT-04

column1: Payment & Reversal
column32:
Business requirement: BR-04 - Pay securely online (Google Pay, Paytm). Payment is returned automatically if an order is rejected or times out.
Functional requirements: FR-06, FR-11
Use cases: UC-08 Make Payment, UC-09 Process Payment, UC-14 Reverse Payment
Business rules: RULE-02, RULE-07, RULE-08
UAT: UAT-05, UAT-06, UAT-08

column1: Restaurant & Delivery Fulfilment
column32:
Business requirements: BR-05 (restaurant accepts/rejects and updates preparation), BR-06 (delivery partner assignment and status)
Functional requirements: FR-07, FR-08
Use cases: UC-11, UC-12, UC-13, UC-15, UC-16
Business rules: RULE-05, RULE-06
UAT: UAT-07, UAT-09

column1: Order Status & Messages
column32:
Business requirements: BR-07 (view order status milestones), BR-08 (in-app messages for payment failure and rejection)
Functional requirements: FR-09, FR-10
Use cases: UC-10 View Order Status (UC-08 failure message)
Business rules: RULE-03, RULE-04
UAT: UAT-06, UAT-08, UAT-10

column1: Restaurant views incoming orders
column32:
As a restaurant, I want to see incoming paid orders on my dashboard, so that I can start handling them.

Acceptance criteria
- Given payment is Successful, Then the order appears on the dashboard with items, customer and amount.
- Orders with Pending Payment are not visible to the restaurant.

Traceability: BR-05, FR-07, UC-11, UAT-07

column1: Restaurant accepts or rejects an order within 5 minutes
column32:
As a restaurant, I want to accept or reject an incoming order, so that customers know whether it will be prepared.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is in Placed status, When I accept it within 5 minutes, Then the status becomes Accepted.
- When I reject it, Then the status becomes Rejected and payment reversal is triggered.

Traceability: BR-05, FR-07, UC-12, RULE-06, UAT-07, UAT-08

column1: Auto-reject order when the restaurant does not respond in 5 minutes
column32:
As a customer, I want an order to be rejected automatically if the restaurant does not respond, so that I am not left waiting.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is Placed and unanswered for 5 minutes, Then it is automatically set to Rejected (RULE-06).
- Then payment reversal is triggered and the customer sees a rejection message.

Traceability: BR-05, FR-07, UC-12, RULE-06, UAT-08

column1: Restaurant updates preparation status
column32:
As a restaurant, I want to mark an order as Preparing and Ready for pickup, so that customers and delivery partners can follow progress.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is Accepted, When I mark Preparing, Then the status becomes Preparing.
- When I mark Ready for pickup, Then the status becomes Ready for Pickup and each change is visible to the customer.

Traceability: BR-05, FR-07, UC-13, UAT-07

column1: Automatically reverse payment for rejected or timed-out orders
column32:
As a customer, I want my payment returned automatically if my order is rejected or times out, so that I am not charged for food I do not receive.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is rejected or times out, Then the system requests a full reversal through the payment gateway.
- Then payment status becomes Refunded and the order status is Rejected (RULE-07).
- The reversal goes to the original payment method.

Traceability: BR-04, FR-11, UC-14, RULE-07, UAT-08

column1: Assign ready orders to an available delivery partner
column32:
As the platform, I want to assign ready orders to an available delivery partner, so that every order can be fulfilled.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is Ready for Pickup, Then it is assigned to an available delivery partner.
- A partner cannot hold more than one active delivery at a time (RULE-05).

Traceability: BR-06, FR-08, UC-15, RULE-05, UAT-09

column1: Delivery partner accepts and picks up an order
column32:
As a delivery partner, I want to accept an assignment and confirm pickup, so that the restaurant and customer know the food is on its way.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is assigned to me, When I accept and tap Mark as picked up, Then the status becomes Picked Up.
- If I try to accept a second order while one is active, Then it is blocked.

Traceability: BR-06, FR-08, UC-15, RULE-05, UAT-09

column1: Delivery partner marks order as delivered
column32:
As a delivery partner, I want to mark an order as delivered, so that the order is completed.

Acceptance criteria
- Given I have picked up an order, When I tap Mark as delivered, Then the order status becomes Delivered.

Traceability: BR-06, FR-08, UC-16, UAT-09

column1: View order status milestones
column32:
As a customer, I want to see my order's status milestones, so that I know how far along my order is.

Acceptance criteria
- Given I have an active order, When I open it, Then milestones Placed, Accepted, Preparing, Ready for pickup, Picked up and Delivered are shown with the current step highlighted.
- The status updates after each change (RULE-04).
- No live map is shown; live GPS tracking is a future enhancement (FE-01).

Traceability: BR-07, FR-09, UC-10, RULE-04, UAT-10

column1: See in-app message when an order is rejected
column32:
As a customer, I want an in-app message when my order is rejected, so that I know my payment is being reversed.

Acceptance criteria
- Given my order is rejected or times out, Then an in-app rejection message is shown immediately (RULE-03).
- The message says my payment is being reversed and offers to browse other restaurants.

Traceability: BR-08, FR-10, UC-10, RULE-03, UAT-08

column1: Pay online with Google Pay or Paytm
column32:
As a customer, I want to pay online with Google Pay or Paytm, so that my order is confirmed securely.

Acceptance criteria
- Given an order is Pending Payment, When payment succeeds, Then payment status is Successful and order status is Placed.
- The order is sent to the restaurant only after payment succeeds (RULE-02).
- No card or UPI credentials are stored by DeliverEats (NFR-09).

Traceability: BR-04, FR-06, UC-08, UC-09, RULE-02, UAT-05

column1: Retry or cancel after failed payment
column32:
As a customer, I want to retry or cancel when my payment fails, so that I do not lose my order.

Acceptance criteria
- Given my payment fails, Then the order is not sent to the restaurant.
- When I tap Retry payment, Then payment is attempted again.
- When I tap Cancel order, Then the order status becomes Cancelled and no money is taken.

Traceability: BR-04, FR-06, UC-08, RULE-02, UAT-06

column1: See in-app message when payment fails
column32:
As a customer, I want an immediate in-app message when my payment fails, so that I know what happened and what to do.

Acceptance criteria
- Given my payment fails, Then a 'Payment failed' message is shown immediately in the app (RULE-03).
- The message states that no money was taken and offers retry or cancel.

Traceability: BR-08, FR-10, UC-08, RULE-03, UAT-06
